No separate courier/wire/notary/CPL/recording figures published on this specific page (see firm's general 'Real Estate Closing Costs' and 'What Is the Cost of Title Insurance in Vermont' pages, both fetched this session -- neither contains additional dollar figures, both route title-insurance-premium questions to CATIC's rate calculator instead of quoting Peet Law's own numbers).
